// Server hosts UDP workers that simulate storage latency.
type Server struct {
	cfg    Config
	policy *ebpfPolicy
	logger *log.Logger

	conns   []*net.UDPConn
	stats   []workerStats
	wg      sync.WaitGroup
	statsWG sync.WaitGroup
}

type workerStats struct {
	mu sync.Mutex

	getCount    uint64
	getErrors   uint64
	getLatency  time.Duration
	scanCount   uint64
	scanErrors  uint64
	scanLatency time.Duration
}

type workerStatsSnapshot struct {
	getCount    uint64
	getErrors   uint64
	getLatency  time.Duration
	scanCount   uint64
	scanErrors  uint64
	scanLatency time.Duration
}

func (ws *workerStats) reset() {
	ws.mu.Lock()
	ws.getCount = 0
	ws.getErrors = 0
	ws.getLatency = 0
	ws.scanCount = 0
	ws.scanErrors = 0
	ws.scanLatency = 0
	ws.mu.Unlock()
}

func (ws *workerStats) recordGet(duration time.Duration, err bool) {
	ws.mu.Lock()
	ws.getCount++
	ws.getLatency += duration
	if err {
		ws.getErrors++
	}
	ws.mu.Unlock()
}

func (ws *workerStats) recordScan(duration time.Duration, err bool) {
	ws.mu.Lock()
	ws.scanCount++
	ws.scanLatency += duration
	if err {
		ws.scanErrors++
	}
	ws.mu.Unlock()
}

def _load_matplotlib():
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(
            "matplotlib is required to generate plots. Install it (e.g. `pip install matplotlib`) "
            "or rerun with --skip-plot."
        ) from exc
    return plt


def generate_overall_plot(experiment_dir: pathlib.Path, records: list[dict]) -> pathlib.Path:
    plt = _load_matplotlib()

    by_policy = defaultdict(list)
    for record in records:
        by_policy[record["policy"]].append(record)

    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
    for policy, items in by_policy.items():
        items_sorted = sorted(items, key=lambda r: r["rate"])
        rates = [r["rate"] for r in items_sorted]
        p99s = [r["overall_latency_p99_avg_ms"] for r in items_sorted]
        stddevs = [r.get("overall_latency_p99_stddev_ms", 0.0) for r in items_sorted]
        plt.errorbar(
            rates,
            p99s,
            yerr=stddevs,
            marker="o",
            capsize=4,
            label=policy,
        )
    plt.ylim(0, 50)

    plt.xlabel("Send rate (req/s)")
    plt.ylabel("Overall latency p99 (ms)")
    plt.title("Overall p99 latency vs. send rate")
    plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.4)
    plt.legend()
    plt.tight_layout()

    plot_path = experiment_dir / "overall_p99_vs_rate.png"
    plt.savefig(plot_path, dpi=200)
    plt.close()
    print(f"Wrote plot: {plot_path}")
    return plot_path

ensure_positive_int() {
  local name="$1"
  local value="$2"
  if [[ ! "$value" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
    echo "$name must be a positive integer (got '$value')" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

resolve_cpu_pool() {
  local source="$1"
  local cpulist=""

  if [[ -n "$source" ]]; then
    cpulist="${source//[[:space:]]/}"
  else
    local default_path="/sys/devices/system/node/node0/cpulist"
    if [[ ! -r "$default_path" ]]; then
      echo "Unable to read NUMA node 0 CPU list from $default_path" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    cpulist=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$default_path")
  fi

  if [[ -z "$cpulist" ]]; then
    echo "Resolved CPU pool is empty" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  mapfile -t AVAILABLE_CPUS < <(expand_cpu_list "$cpulist") || {
    echo "Failed to parse CPU list '$cpulist'" >&2
    exit 1
  }
  if (( ${#AVAILABLE_CPUS[@]} == 0 )); then
    echo "Resolved CPU pool contains no CPUs" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  if [[ -n "$source" ]]; then
    local cpu
    for cpu in "${AVAILABLE_CPUS[@]}"; do
      if [[ ! -d "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu${cpu}" ]]; then
        echo "CPU $cpu is not present on this system" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
    done
  fi
}

ensure_taskset_available() {
  if ! command -v "$TASKSET_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Required cpu pinning tool '$TASKSET_BIN' not found in PATH" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

  --scan-limit <n>    SCAN limit (default: $SCAN_LIMIT)
  --listen <addr>     UDP listen address (default: $LISTEN)
  --get-delay <dur>   synthetic GET latency (e.g. 10us; passed to server)
  --scan-delay <dur>  synthetic SCAN latency (e.g. 2ms; passed to server)
  --send-workers <n>  concurrent client send goroutines (default: $SEND_WORKERS)
  --iterations <n>    number of workload iterations (default: $ITERATIONS)
  --output-dir <path> directory where run artifacts are written (default: $OUTPUT_ROOT)
  --run-id <id>       override autogenerated run identifier
  --state-dir <path>  directory for server pid/temporary state
  --server-cores <n>  number of dedicated NUMA node 0 cores for the server
  --client-cores <n>  number of dedicated NUMA node 0 cores for the client
USAGE
}

OPTS=$(getopt -o '' \
  --long threads:,policy:,duration:,rate:,get-frac:,scan-limit:,listen:,get-delay:,scan-delay:,send-workers:,iterations:,output-dir:,run-id:,state-dir:,server-cores:,client-cores:,help \
  -n 'run.sh' -- "$@") || { usage; exit 1; }

eval set -- "$OPTS"

if (( total_requested > ${#AVAILABLE_CPUS[@]} )); then
  echo "Insufficient CPUs in selected pool: requested ${total_requested}, available ${#AVAILABLE_CPUS[@]} (${AVAILABLE_CPUS[*]})." >&2

  echo "Server cores not supplied; defaulting to --threads value ($SERVER_CORES)"

if (( DEFAULTED_CLIENT )); then

ensure_taskset_available

"$ROOT/scripts/cleanup_ebpf_maps.sh"

CLIENT_LOG_FILE="$LOG_DIR/client.log"
mkdir -p "$SERVER_LOG_DIR"

else

run_client() {
  local args=("$@")
  local cmd=()
  if [[ -n "$CLIENT_CPUSET" ]]; then
    cmd+=("$TASKSET_BIN" "-c" "$CLIENT_CPUSET")
  fi
  cmd+=("${CLIENT_BASE_CMD[@]}")
  cmd+=("${args[@]}")

META

echo "== Starting server =="
LAUNCH_ARGS=(

  -p "$POLICY"
  -l "$LISTEN"

  -r "$RUN_DIR"
)
if [[ -n "$GET_DELAY" ]]; then
  LAUNCH_ARGS+=(-g "$GET_DELAY")
fi
if [[ -n "$SCAN_DELAY" ]]; then
  LAUNCH_ARGS+=(-s "$SCAN_DELAY")
fi
PID_FILE="$STATE_DIR/server.pid"
SERVER_PID=""

[File: run.sh]
start_server() {
  "$ROOT/scripts/launch_server.sh" "${LAUNCH_ARGS[@]}" >/dev/null
  if [[ ! -f "$PID_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Failed to start server: expected PID file at $PID_FILE" >&2
    SERVER_PID=""
    return 1
  fi

  SERVER_PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE")
  sleep 2

  if ! kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Server process (pid=$SERVER_PID) exited immediately after launch; see logs under $SERVER_LOG_DIR" >&2
    SERVER_PID=""
    return 1
  fi

  local server_log="$SERVER_LOG_DIR/server.log"
  if [[ -f "$server_log" ]]; then
    if grep -qiE "initialise server|load agent objects" "$server_log"; then
      echo "Server reported an agent load failure; see $server_log" >&2
      stop_server
      return 1
    fi
  fi

  return 0
}

stop_server() {
  if [[ -f "$PID_FILE" ]]; then
    local pid
    pid=$(cat "$PID_FILE")
    if kill -0 "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      kill "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  elif [[ -n "${SERVER_PID:-}" ]]; then
    if kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  rm -f "$PID_FILE"
  SERVER_PID=""
}

echo "pprof available at http://127.0.0.1:6060/debug/pprof/"
echo "block/mutex profiling enabled (SetBlockProfileRate=1)"

  echo "== Warmup (${WARMUP_DURATION}s) =="
  pushd "$ROOT" >/dev/null
  run_client \
    -server "$LISTEN" \
    -duration "${WARMUP_DURATION}s" \
    -rate "$RATE" \
    -get-frac "$GET_FRAC" \
    -scan-limit "$SCAN_LIMIT" \
    -send-workers "$SEND_WORKERS" \
    -log /dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  popd >/dev/null
fi

stop_server

WORKLOAD_SUMMARY="$LOG_DIR/workload_summary.txt"
> "$WORKLOAD_SUMMARY"

echo "== Running workload iterations ($ITERATIONS) =="
pushd "$ROOT" >/dev/null
ITERATION_LOGS=()

[File: run.sh]
for ((i = 1; i <= ITERATIONS; i++)); do
  ITER_LOG="$LOG_DIR/workload_iteration_${i}.txt"
  ITERATION_LOGS+=("$ITER_LOG")
  echo "-- Iteration $i/$ITERATIONS --"
  echo "Restarting server for iteration $i"
  if ! start_server; then
    echo "Failed to start server for iteration $i; aborting run" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  run_client \
    -server "$LISTEN" \
    -duration "${DURATION}s" \
    -rate "$RATE" \
    -get-frac "$GET_FRAC" \
    -scan-limit "$SCAN_LIMIT" \
    -send-workers "$SEND_WORKERS" \
    -log "$CLIENT_LOG_FILE" | tee "$ITER_LOG"
  if grep -qiE 'initialise server|load agent objects' "$ITER_LOG"; then
    echo "Detected server load failure during iteration $i; aborting remaining runs." >&2
    stop_server
    exit 1
  fi
  if grep -qi 'connection refused' "$CLIENT_LOG_FILE"; then
    echo "Client observed connection refusals during iteration $i; aborting remaining runs." >&2
    stop_server
    exit 1
  fi
  if grep -qi 'No responses received' "$ITER_LOG"; then
    echo "Workload reported no responses during iteration $i; aborting remaining runs." >&2
    stop_server
    exit 1
  fi
  stop_server
done
popd >/dev/null

for idx in "${!ITERATION_LOGS[@]}"; do
  iter=$((idx + 1))
  {
    echo "== Iteration $iter =="
    cat "${ITERATION_LOGS[$idx]}"
    echo
  } >> "$WORKLOAD_SUMMARY"
done

echo "== Aggregating workload metrics =="
